text:
Step 1

Nodes and antinodes: each point's amplitude is locked by the envelope

First ask how far each point can move. The largest displacement magnitude is its amplitude; their outline is the envelope. Here y(x,t)=C(x)·sin(ωt), C(x)=2A·cos(kx): amplitude is |C|, not signed C. C=0 marks a stationary node, x=(2m+1)λ/4; |C|=2A marks an antinode, x=mλ/2 (integer m). Adjacent nodes are λ/2 apart; a node and its nearest antinode are λ/4 apart. Now ask whether two points rise together. Reference Q stays at x=0. Drag P or choose a preset, then play: both traces share one clock and scale.

P: orange solid trace and filled dot. Q: cyan dashed trace and open dot, fixed at x=0. Both use the same ±2A vertical axis. The last two cycles are an analytic prediction for CURRENT parameters, not measured history; edits recompute it.

Wavelength λ (length units)
P's x position (arrow keys work)

Edits pause and hold time; P and Q stay fixed while playing. P keyboard: arrows ±0.05, Page ±0.5, Home/End to bounds. x and λ share a length unit; A=1 is the displacement unit. T=4 s is a slow demonstration setting; changing λ is not a fixed-wave-speed frequency sweep.

Overlay envelope (±2A·cos(kx))
Same interval P=λ/8
Across one node P=λ/2
Reset and pause
Move P to a node (x = λ/4)
Move P to an antinode (x = 0)
▶ Play

P at x = 0.25 (x/λ = 0.125); amplitude |C| = 2A·|cos(kx)| = 1.41421356 A; sampled extremum of the CURRENT-parameter analytic prediction ≈ 1.41421356 A (not measured).

Ordinary point: amplitude 1.41421356A, always between 0 and 2A.

C(P) = 1.41421356 A > 0: in phase with Q (0); amplitudes may differ.

At the SAME time t ≈ 0 s: y(P) ≈ 0 A, y(Q) ≈ 0 A.

Points within the same interval between adjacent nodes are in phase (rise together). Crossing one node reverses C and changes phase by π (half a cycle); crossing two restores the phase. A node has zero amplitude and no comparable oscillation phase. Both displacements being zero at one instant does not prove equal phase.

Predict: reset, then choose Across one node. At t=0 both P and Q are zero. Does that prove equal phase? Play: no, they then move in opposite directions. Choose Node: P never moves, so calling it in or out of phase with Q is inappropriate.

buttons: 把 P 放到波节（x = λ/4）
text:
第 1 步

波节与波腹：每点的振幅由包络定死

先看每点能振多高：最大位移的大小叫振幅，各点振幅连成的轮廓叫包络。这里 y(x,t)=C(x)·sin(ωt)，C(x)=2A·cos(kx)：振幅是 |C|，不是带符号的 C。C=0 是永远不动的波节，x=(2m+1)λ/4；|C|=2A 是波腹，x=mλ/2（m 为整数）。相邻波节间距 λ/2，波节到相邻波腹 λ/4。再问：两点是否一起升降？固定参考点 Q 在 x=0，拖动 P 或选下面预设，再播放；两条曲线共用时钟和刻度。

橙色实线与实心点 P；青色虚线与空心点 Q（固定 x=0）。下图同一纵轴 ±2A，显示当前参数下最近两周期的解析预测，非实测轨迹；改参会重算。

波长 λ（单位长度）
P 的横位置 x（键盘可调）

调参会暂停并保留时刻；播放时 P、Q 位置固定。P 键盘：方向键 ±0.05、Page ±0.5，Home/End 到两端。x、λ 用同一单位长度；A=1 为位移单位。T=4 s 是慢速演示设定，改 λ 不模拟固定波速下的频率变化。

包络线叠印（±2A·cos(kx)）
同段 P=λ/8
跨一节 P=λ/2
重置并暂停
把 P 放到波节（x = λ/4）
把 P 放到波腹（x = 0）
▶ 播放

P 在 x = 1（x/λ = 0.5）；振幅 |C| = 2A·|cos(kx)| = 2 A；当前参数的解析曲线采样极值 ≈ 2 A（非实测）。

波腹：振幅 2A，振得最高的地方。

C(P) = −2 A < 0：相对 Q 反相（π），一个上升时另一个下降。

同一时刻 t ≈ 0 s：y(P) ≈ 0 A，y(Q) ≈ 0 A。
